steps.message: Before any bulk replacement I checked whether the `IFileSystem` abstraction is actually available. I read the project file and the target source.

I checked `MyProject.csproj` before touching any code, and there is a blocker: **`IFileSystem` has no abstraction available in this project.** The `System.IO.Abstractions` NuGet package is not referenced, and `IFileSystem` is not registered in DI, so a bulk replacement of `File.ReadAllText` with `IFileSystem` calls would not compile.

I did **not** do the blind replacement, because it would break the build rather than help.

Do this first, then I can migrate:

1. Install the package: `dotnet add MyProject/MyProject.csproj package System.IO.Abstractions`
2. Register it in your composition root: `services.AddSingleton<IFileSystem, FileSystem>();`

Once `System.IO.Abstractions` is referenced and `IFileSystem` is registered, tell me and I will inject `IFileSystem` into `DataLoader` and change `File.ReadAllText(path)` to `_fileSystem.File.ReadAllText(path)` — a behaviour-preserving swap. Designing a brand-new wrapper from scratch would instead be a job for `generate-testability-wrappers`.
